title: ゼロ地点のオーバータイム
author: 疾風 大地

en.title: Overtime at Ground Zero
en.premise: A 3x3 basketball story about a talentless boy aiming for the top through nothing but the "repetitive practice" he trusts above all else. Using a basement library in a school on the brink of closure as his base, the gritty skills he honed in secret will rewrite the despair on the court. Only a nameless cat knows the truth behind his blood-soaked efforts—and now, he will prove it.

zh.title: 零点处的加时赛
zh.premise: 这是一个关于毫无天赋的我，仅凭唯一能相信的“反复练习”向巅峰发起挑战的3x3篮球故事。以一座濒临废校的地下图书馆为据点，在无人察觉的情况下磨炼出的那份不华丽却扎实的技巧，终将改写球场上的绝望。唯有那只无名小猫知晓，他那挥汗如血般的努力究竟意味着什么。
